description: Price quotation for a reproduction of an artwork, as an art print or a hand-painted oil painting, at a given size and in a given currency. Leave type out to get BOTH in one call: the result then holds "quotations" (one full quotation per type the artwork sells, each with its own price, buy_url and offer_text) and "types_not_available". Every quotation carries offer_text, one ready-to-paste line (type, size, frame, price, order link): give it to the user as is, translating its words if needed but never changing its numbers or link. Optional frame_code adds the frame price to quotation_price ("WhiteWrap" = stretched on stretcher bars, "default" = a decorative frame chosen for the artwork, or a catalog code); optional senior_artist (oil painting only) adds the "Elite Senior Artist" upgrade — more detail and finesse, extra production time — to quotation_price. Identify the artwork by pk, or by title and/or artist_name (an exact title match wins; otherwise the first good-confidence search match is used, and its relevance is returned in "score"). A fuzzy match can be a different painting than the one asked for: when the result carries a "warning", verify the returned title before using the price, as the warning instructs. width/height need not match the artwork's own proportions: when its aspect ratio is known, the quoted size is snapped to that ratio while keeping the same surface area (width x height) you requested, so the reproduction is never stretched or distorted; the actual quoted size is returned as width_cm/height_cm (vs. your original requested_width_cm/requested_height_cm), with size_ratio_adjusted set to true when this happened. Give only width OR only height (e.g. "25 cm high", "smallest side 25 cm") to keep that side exactly: the other side is then derived from the artwork's aspect ratio and size_derived_from names the side you gave (fails with invalid_size when the ratio is unknown - then give both). Each side must be 25-250 cm (about 10-98 inches): a size outside that range is NOT refused but quoted at the nearest valid size with the same proportions, with size_adjusted_to_minimum / size_adjusted_to_maximum set to true; whenever the quoted size differs from the request, size_note says in one sentence what changed and why - repeat it to the user. invalid_size only comes back when no size of these proportions can fit the range. Returns pk, artist_name, title, meta_description, quotation_price, currency, frame_code (+ frame_description, frame_delivery), url (catalog page) and buy_url. buy_url is a ready-to-open, fully-parameterised buy form: reproduction medium, size and frame are all set from the query string, so the page opens showing exactly quotation_price. Give it to the user as the link to order the artwork at the quoted configuration. When the artwork ITSELF is for sale right now (a ready-made oil painting in stock, an open auction lot, an original, a studio collectible), the result also carries available_now (offers with price, stock quantity and offer_text, plus a note): tell the customer about the real object in the same answer — a quotation is a copy made to order. An artwork sold only as such an object answers with quotations empty and available_now set, not with channel_not_available.

artist_name.description: Artist name (used when pk is not given).

frame_code.description: Optional frame; when set, quotation_price includes it. Omit it (or "NoFrame") for the canvas rolled in a tube. "WhiteWrap" = the canvas stretched on wooden stretcher bars, white edges, no outer frame (use it for any request for a stretcher, stretcher bars, a stretched canvas or a canvas ready to hang without a frame); "BlurSideWrap" / "ExtendedWrap" = the same with the image blurred / continued around the edges. "default" = a decorative outer frame chosen for you (the frame recommended for the artwork when it has one, else our best-selling frame) — use it to quote a framed option without knowing the catalog. Any other catalog code (e.g. "P118B", "P919G", "W316G", "H24-GOLD-Portrait") is that specific decorative frame. The result then carries frame_description, frame_delivery (assembled, or a disassembled kit over 105 cm) and, for "default", frame_chosen_by. buy_url prefills the frame.

height.description: Height in the given unit. Omit to derive it from width.

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

senior_artist.description: Oil painting only: have an Elite Senior Artist paint it (more detail, finesse and extra production time). When true, quotation_price includes the upgrade and buy_url pre-selects it.

title.description: Artwork title (used when pk is not given).

type.description: Reproduction type: "print" (art print) or "oil painting" (hand-painted). Omit to quote both at once.

width.description: Width in the given unit. Omit to derive it from height.

name: get_a_quotation
title: Get a reproduction price quotation
